items.title: Sadie Goodson Interview, 1984-12-12
items.q: The doctor called, come down to the emergency room, Ms. Guston. I said, okay. Come down to the emergency room.

ctx.x: Most states they do, they record it. The state capital too.

Joel can tell you things like that. He worked for lawyers, he knows all that stuff. Uh huh, yeah. Well my sister, I tried to get it for me when I was in New York. You see when I graduated I had to have my license and then when I took up my driving license I had my license. My age, you know, I mean my license. Right. And when I went to school I had to show that to her. So I had to, she had to try to get me something, you know. When Washington told me to write to the census bureau, Kansas, Pittsburgh, Kansas, that…
